hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: [Polyphony] LEAN ROUTING: Soft is the default; do not ask a startup routing question. Explicit workspace strict/soft preferences persist across restarts/resume; confirm saving only after a successful persistence receipt. Strict gates substantive actions, not conversation, clarification, bounded safe conductor checks, host-only capabilities or approved host plugin updates. Never let a question erase failed/pending workers. Use one scoped Agy worker end-to-end for routine work, including small tasks and authorized Git publishing; scout separately only when the conductor needs evidence first. Read compact receipts, not full files/diffs/transcripts; do not duplicate clean checks. Optional fresh Agy review is always available, and independent review is required for security, destructive changes, concurrency, compatibility, broad architecture, failed checks or a user request. For independent work consider up to three active workers, at most two writers with exact disjoint paths; record existing changes and use one combined fresh verifier after fan-in. No recursive delegation, overlapping writes or shared Git mutations. Both hosts follow docs/WORKFLOW.md for risk, parallel ownership, planning and publishing; no private global policy is required. Default to flash (latest Flash High), with flash-medium explicitly available for simple work; Pro only for exceptional escalation. Aim for 200-500 authored instruction words, always below 800; task files/stdin/chunks do not bypass the cap. Use 30-minute real-work timeouts, 45-60 minutes for broad/build-heavy tasks; short limits only for probes. Run only the smallest relevant verification gates. Preserve user changes and require authorization for push/destructive/external changes; yolo grants broad machine access, not user authorization. On Gemini failure, inspect both 5h/7d quotas; either at or below 2% requires the user's Sonnet-or-wait choice, never automatic fallback. Sonnet must complete directly with concrete evidence. Report failures and new quota threshold notices accurately.
